summary: Withrow's platform calls for an immediate stop to U.S. weapons transfers to Israel, arguing self-defense does not justify killing or annexing sovereign neighbors. His foreign policy is framed as anti-war on all fronts, opposing the propping up of brutal regimes and the funding of conflicts. He supports a two-state solution on pre-1967 borders as the best available path to peace and recognition.
